# 2026-10-30 CDT — Simulated public candidate sample

`2026-10-30-simulated-public-candidate-sample.jsonl` contains the first 64 candidate rows from the default offline replay of the public handoff 09 allowlist capture. It is 48,894 bytes. It is a truncated **Simulated** research output sample, not a complete run or profitability evidence. The full JSONL, summary, request/result files and input/output hashes are under `~/MEVanaData/replay/handoff11-default-run2/`; no capture data is committed.

`2026-10-30-r2-ordered-routes.json` is the complete 152-route R2 order generated by the .NET `ExperimentRequestV2RouteEnumerator` using the public handoff 09 standard-fee allowlist and the handoff 12 catalog window. Both .NET and Rust compare their ordered enumeration against these 53,141 bytes. It contains route identifiers only, with no capture account bytes or opportunity result.
